caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, quilt-like design set against a plain cream background. The central focus is a large, multi-layered, starburst or diamond pattern that radiates outward in successive bands of color. These bands are made up of small, zigzag or triangular shapes in a repeating geometric pattern, with colors including red, green, blue, yellow, black, and white. Surrounding the central starburst is a wide border filled with intricate floral and leafy motifs in shades of pink, red, green, blue, and black, intricately interwoven with vines and curvilinear forms against a white background. The entire design is framed by an additional thin border line, which contains a continuous scrolling vine motif with green leaves and pinkish-red flowers. The composition is symmetrical and densely decorated, with the main geometric form in the center and florals in the border, forming a complete, balanced rectangle. In the lower left corner of the page, there is a lightly sketched square and some hand-written numbers.
title: Patchwork and Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
